{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Attention'', starfighter&mdash;this is a ''restricted area''. Please ''state your business'' or we will be forced to escort you ''off-planet''.|Pilot of a single-pod cloud car, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Foreclosure">{{TCWComicCite|6.7|Foreclosure}}</ref>}}
This '''single-pod cloud car''' was a small [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] utilized as security by the [[Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory]].

==Characteristics==
The cloud car was similar in design to the [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]], but with a single pod.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], two such [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] intercepted [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|fighter]], informing him that he was in a restricted area and they would escort him off-world unless he clarified his business. After he did so, the speeder [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] directed him towards a landing bay.
